mapper.select: SELECT tr.category_seq AS categorySeq, tr.type AS type, SUM(tr.amount) AS total FROM transaction tr WHERE tr.account_book_seq = #{accountBookSeq, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tr.user_seq = #{userSeq, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tr.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND #{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY tr.category_seq, tr.type
